# Miranova

> Personal portfolio page for Claira Mira Shaw.
> Publishes exploratory work on emergence, shared cognitive substrates, and structural participation.

## Core Work

- [The Commons](https://miranova.dev/commons.md): A shared cognitive substrate built using the Miranova Matrix.
- [The Miranova Matrix](https://miranova.dev/matrix.md): Framework for describing structural properties of emergence.
